post.description:
Create a custom tool in Draft status.

This creates the tool record only. Upload its source and build a version in separate requests.

ETag.description: ETag to send in If-Match when changing this tool.

delete.description: Delete this custom tool and release its name for reuse.

parameters.description: The custom tool name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Optional: send the `etag` field returned in the Get tool JSON body, including its quotes, to avoid overwriting changes made since that read. Standard If-Match lists and `*` are also accepted; `*` checks only that the tool exists. Without this header, changes apply to the current tool state and may overwrite concurrent edits.
parameters.name: If-Match

get.description:
Get a custom tool and one version.

By default this includes the latest version. Pass `version=v2` to inspect a specific version.
A tool that has never been built returns `version: null`.

parameters.description: The custom tool name.
parameters.name: name

anyOf.description: A version number such as `v3`. Omit it to use the endpoint's documented default.

parameters.description: Optional SDK-managed identity condition. A retained Tool or Version ETag prevents a read from silently switching to a replacement tool with the same name. Representation changes within the same resource remain readable.
parameters.name: If-Match

patch.description:
Update a custom tool's metadata or compute resources.

Fields you omit are left unchanged.

parameters.description: The custom tool name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Optional: send the `etag` field returned in the Get tool JSON body, including its quotes, to avoid overwriting changes made since that read. Standard If-Match lists and `*` are also accepted; `*` checks only that the tool exists. Without this header, changes apply to the current tool state and may overwrite concurrent edits.
parameters.name: If-Match

ETag.description: ETag to send in If-Match when changing this tool.

post.description:
Build a version from an uploaded source archive.

The archive also updates the tool's editable source and configuration. Optionally send the Tool
`etag` field from the Get tool JSON body to reject concurrent edits. Without it, the current tool is updated.
Returns immediately with the new or reused version and its current status.

parameters.description: The custom tool name.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Retries the same build request without admitting duplicate work. Reusing a key with different source or runtime facts returns 409 Conflict.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Retries the same build request without admitting duplicate work. Reusing a key with different source or runtime facts returns 409 Conflict.

post.description:
Request cancellation of an active build.

When exactly one build is active, no version is needed. If multiple builds are active, pass a
version such as `version=v2`. Cancellation is a request; continue polling for the outcome.

parameters.name: name
